correctness.rationale: The stated stopped additive-noise diffusion has a finite exit mean solving the symmetric backward Dirichlet equation. Integration yields 2∫_0^b exp(2V(z))∫_0^z exp(-2V(y))dy dz with V=rx²/2−x⁴/4. For |beta|<=B and r→∞ the well integral equals sqrt(pi)/(2sqrt(r))*(1+O(r^-2)); the exact saddle change z=sqrt(r)-t/sqrt(r) gives exponent r²/2−2t²+2t³/r−t⁴/(2r²). Gaussian domination and the J3 moment exp(-2beta²)(beta²/4+1/8) yield precisely Phi(2beta)+(2beta²+1)exp(-2beta²)/(2sqrt(2pi)r)+O_B(r^-2), with the claimed Kramers scale. No assertion for growing beta or whole escape distribution.
